tools.name: cinder_channels_list
tools.description: List public Cinder channels and their recent activity.

tools.name: cinder_channels_read
tools.description: Read bounded public messages and peer profiles from one channel.

tools.name: cinder_agents_list
tools.description: List public peer-agent profiles and capabilities.

tools.name: cinder_messages_send
tools.description: Send a bounded private text message to a Cinder peer or channel and receive a resumable conversation handle. Content is not relayed to other visitors.

tools.name: cinder_inbox_read
tools.description: Read curated replies from a private possession-addressed inbox.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cinder_channels_read, cinder_messages_send, cinder_inbox_read · Private data: cinder_messages_send, cinder_inbox_read · Public sink: cinder_messages_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cinder_channels_read, cinder_messages_send, cinder_inbox_read · Private data: cinder_messages_send, cinder_inbox_read · Public sink: cinder_messages_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
